selection_rationale: Uses only the existing conserved Layer-ROM state S_i; no new root-specific memory is introduced.
Uses the exact retained-layer root fraction Delta F_i.
Uses the unchanged frozen retention relation to map mean water content to one representative pressure head.
Uses the unchanged drought-only Feddes alpha(h) law.
Contains no fitted coefficient, relaxation time, error correction or C6P-derived tuning.
The same formula was frozen in C6P before ambiguity was evaluated, where it was explicitly classified as a diagnostic rather than an accepted closure.
formula: Delta F_i = integral of prescribed root-fraction density over retained layer i
selected_reduced_feedback.known_structural_limit: C6P proves that the fine root-weighted alpha(h) functional is not uniquely determined by S_i and that the mean-head evaluation is not exact.

reference_feedback_contract.evaluation_state: Committed hydraulic pressure-head state, matching current SWAP5 root process semantics.
reference_feedback_contract.trial_semantics: The evaluated sink vector is then prescribed during the Richards trial, consistent with the admitted concrete root-sink provider semantics.
reference_feedback_contract.candidate_semantics: Reduced feedback is likewise evaluated once from the committed retained state and held prescribed during the reduced hydraulic trial.
reference_feedback_contract.synchronization_rule: Reference and candidate must receive the same T_p, root-distribution and Feddes parameter schedule at each committed step.

root_active_reference_design_principles.boundary: Use the already-admitted fixed bottom-flux DYN0A numerical route; do not reopen free-drainage or fixed-head retry authority.
root_active_reference_design_principles.surface_forcing: Keep top and bottom hydraulic flux at the initial gravity-equilibrium value in the first mechanistic root-feedback Reference. Root extraction is the sole driver of net drying.
root_active_reference_design_principles.stress_levels: Use a frozen synthetic mechanism set first; do not claim crop calibration.
root_active_reference_design_principles.numerical_hierarchy: Use the C6N0/C6N1 three-level space-time uncertainty method rather than the failed C6M2 dominance rule.

prospective_candidate_scope_after_refere.rationale: C6N2 identifies U4/U8 as purpose-relevant surface controls while retaining R8 as the groundwater-oriented same-dimension contrast and R16 as the no-spatial-reduction LARE control.

interpretation_boundary: C6Q selects a candidate approximation for falsification, not an accepted ET closure.
A failure of the mean-head route would not prove that all low-dimensional ET models require new state; it would reject this minimum existing-state approximation on the tested domain.
A successful comparator-relative result still requires an independent application tolerance before operational ET/drought acceptance.

next_authority.question: Can a fresh root-active fixed-flux Reference panel with committed-state drought-only Feddes feedback be numerically qualified by a three-level space-time uncertainty hierarchy before any reduced feedback response?
